tools.name: dialog_ask_store_assistant
tools.description: Ask 3INA Makeup's shopping assistant, an expert on its catalog, buying guides and policies, an open question and get a written answer in the shopper's language plus up to 5 recommended products (title, url, price, currency, availability). Use it when the shopper needs advice rather than a lookup: which product fits a use case or budget, how two products compare, what to pair with an item, or a shipping or returns question the policies leave open (triggers: "which one should I", "what do you recommend", "is X better than Y", "does it work with"). To list, search or open pages use search_catalog or get_product. Follow-up questions keep the conversation context; one question per call. Read-only: never changes the page or the cart.

question.description: The question, in the shopper's language, with the context the assistant needs (use case, budget, constraints).

tools.name: dialog_search_products
tools.description: Search 3INA Makeup's product catalog by name, brand or keyword, with the same engine as the store's search bar, and get matching products (title, url, price, currency, availability) plus the total hit count. Use it when the shopper names a product or asks whether the store carries something (triggers: "do you have", "find", "search for", "is there a"). Results match product titles, so for needs, budgets or comparisons use dialog_ask_store_assistant instead. Read-only: never changes the page or the cart.

query.description: Product name, brand or keywords, in the store language.
